questions.prompt: It's turn one and your hand offers two openings. You...

answers.text: Play a cheap unit now, ready to take a battlefield next turn.
Play a card that gives you an extra rune for the rest of the game, and let them take the early points.

questions.prompt: Two cheap spells, same cost. Which one makes your deck?

answers.text: Deals 2 damage to an enemy unit.
Stuns two enemy units, so they deal no combat damage this turn.

questions.prompt: Filling out your deck, you give more slots to...

answers.text: Units, and cards that make your units stronger.
Spells that answer whatever your opponent puts down.

questions.prompt: Your unit is about to lose a fight. The trick you'd rather have...

answers.text: Gives their unit −2 might this turn.
Gives your unit +2 might this turn.

questions.prompt: Your deck is one card over. Which goes?

answers.text: Cut the card that wins the game on a good draw and sits dead in your hand on a bad one.
Cut the card that's always useful and never spectacular.

questions.prompt: A powerful effect asks a price. You'd rather pay by...

answers.text: Discarding two cards from your hand.
Giving up one of your units.

questions.prompt: Your opponent has two face-down cards and three in hand. You...

answers.text: Enjoy working out what they might be.
Would rather play your game and deal with them when they show up.

questions.prompt: Two 4-cost units, same might. You'd rather have the one that...

answers.text: Can enter ready for a little extra to attack at once, and draws you a card if it conquers that turn.
Looks at the top two cards of your deck when it lands, and you draw the one you want.

questions.prompt: Which win feels better?

answers.text: Winning on turn nine, after all your best cards have come out.
Winning on turn four, before their best cards come out.

questions.prompt: Two units, same cost and might. You'd rather run the one that...

answers.text: Leaves two 1-might soldiers behind when it dies.
Draws you a card each time it holds a battlefield at the start of your turn.

questions.prompt: You're about to attack and you have the numbers. You...

answers.text: Commit everything. If it works the game is nearly over; if they have an answer, you're in trouble.
Commit just enough to win the fight, even if it gives them time to recover.

questions.prompt: Two 5-cost units with the same might. Which makes your deck?

answers.text: The one that gives you an extra rune for the rest of the game when it lands.
The one that gets +1 might whenever it's the one attacking.

questions.prompt: It's your turn and you could spend every rune or keep some back. You...

answers.text: Keep some back so you can react to whatever they do on their turn.
Spend everything now and put another unit on the board.

questions.prompt: Add one card to the deck:

answers.text: A cheap spell that has you discard two cards, then draw four.
An expensive unit, bigger than almost anything they can play.

questions.prompt: You have four cards to play this turn and the order matters. You...

answers.text: Enjoy it. Working out the exact order is the best bit.
Would rather play cards strong enough that the order takes care of itself.

questions.prompt: Two units cost the same and hit the same. You take the one that...

answers.text: Takes the hits first for the units fighting alongside it.
Can be hidden face down at a battlefield and sprung on them later, even mid-fight.

questions.prompt: Turn three. They're ahead on points, but you have more runes and a better hand. You feel...

answers.text: Relaxed. The later turns are mine.
Itchy. I'd trade some of that hand to get on the scoreboard now.

questions.prompt: The most expensive card in your deck should be...

answers.text: A gear that draws you an extra card every turn it stays in play.
A spell that plays your best unit straight from the trash, ignoring its cost.

questions.prompt: A deck that's unbeatable when the draws line up and falls apart when they don't is more fun than one that plays out much the same every game.
One unit slot left. It goes to a unit that...

answers.text: When it lands and each time it conquers, one of your units gets a lasting +1 might.
Brings two 1-might soldiers along when it arrives.

questions.prompt: The best moment in a game is when my opponent commits to a play and I have the exact answer waiting. That beats landing a big play of my own.
Two 4-cost units, same might. You'd rather have the one that...

answers.text: Kills an enemy unit with 1 might or less when it lands.
Deals 2 damage to an enemy unit each time it conquers a battlefield.

questions.prompt: The turn you enjoy most is...

answers.text: One where every card you play does its job without needing the others.
One where cards you set up over several turns finally click together.

questions.prompt: Two 3-cost units, same might, each with an effect when it lands. You'd rather have the one that...

answers.text: Sends an enemy unit back to its base when it lands.
Shrinks an enemy unit by 2 whenever it attacks or defends.

questions.prompt: I want a game decided in the first few turns, whichever way it goes.
I play best with a deck that has one clear job, so I can focus on doing it well.
Your deck wins with...

answers.text: Many solid threats across the deck, so no single draw decides the game, for better or worse.
A few explosive cards that win the game on their own, if you draw them in time.
